Vented_Helm_Skull.description: A heavy, featureless greathelm serving as the entity's cranium. Lacking biological brains, its internal cavity is merely a high-pressure valve chamber for venting excess arcane or steam energy.

Faceless_Monolith.description: A completely blank, uncarved slab of solid stone acting as the head. Lacking a mouth, eyes, or ears, it projects an aura of terrifying, inhuman inevitability.
